content: Data We used EHR data from MIMIC-III BIBREF21 and conducted all our experiments on a cohort where patients have more than one visit. We utilize data from patients with both single visit and multiple visits in the training dataset as pre-training data source (multi-visit data are split into visit slices). In this work, we transform the drug coding from NDC to ATC Third Level for using the ontology information. The statistics of the datasets are summarized in Table 2 .
